suggestions.text: Ruby and Tyson meet a customer who insists the bakery’s mascot should judge the neighborhood baking competition.
Tyson tries to prove the bakery is not haunted after a fresh loaf appears on the cooling rack with no one claiming it.
The celebration-cake customer changes their competition-themed design at the last possible minute.
Ruby brings a mascot candidate to the bakery, and Tyson worries it will derail the new closing routine.
A sudden rush for seasonal pastries forces Ruby and Tyson to improvise a neighborhood tasting table.
Ruby and Tyson test a few mascot ideas during a busy morning, only to discover the neighborhood has very strong opinions.
A competition organizer visits to confirm Fox & Flour’s cake order, and Tyson realizes the event has stricter rules than Ruby expected.
After another eerie noise comes from the freezer, Ruby insists they finally investigate what is actually back there.
The new closing routine is put to the test when a last-minute customer arrives just as Ruby and Tyson are ready to leave.
Fox & Flour hosts a tasting of seasonal pastries, and Ruby tries to persuade Tyson to add an unexpectedly bold flavor to the menu.

The bakery’s celebration-cake order for the neighborhood baking competition creates awkward questions about whether Fox & Flour can enter, judge, or simply stay out of it.
Tyson investigates a new late-night noise in the bakery and finds evidence that makes the haunting theory harder to dismiss.
Ruby insists on practicing the new closing routine, but Tyson realizes they have each interpreted “what they need” very differently.
A mystery customer asks for a pastry based on an old neighborhood recipe, sending Ruby and Tyson on a search for its missing details.
